name: Nimbus Fabrication Pulse Bracelet
description:
A slim wrist-worn band that monitors pulse, blood oxygen, stress hormones, and neural activity baseline in real time. The band's exterior is featureless matte black; all data is transmitted to a paired device or AR display. A panic-button feature sends the wearer's location and vitals to pre-designated contacts when double-tapped.

Used by corponation employees whose employers monitor their biometrics as a condition of employment, and independently by individuals who want a dead-man's switch — if the heart stops, the bracelet talks.
functionality: Real-time biometric monitoring, panic alert, dead-man's switch capability
what_it_says: Your body's vital signs are being watched, either by your employer or by someone who cares whether you're still alive.
story_hooks: A Pulse Bracelet's dead-man's switch activates, transmitting a final location — but the wearer is found alive and well at that location, with no memory of the last four hours and vitals that show they technically died and restarted.
